title: How do you run integration tests in a CI pipeline?
description: Use test containers, ephemeral databases, and cleanup strategies.

data.text: Question: How do you run integration tests in a CI pipeline?
Use ephemeral databases or Testcontainers, seed known data, run tests in parallel, and clean up resources after the job.

items: Testcontainers: spin up SQL Server in Docker
WebApplicationFactory: in-memory or real DB for API tests
Parallelism: run tests across multiple jobs
Cleanup: drop containers or truncate tables in finally
Artifacts: publish test results and coverage reports
Relying on a shared persistent database
Not handling flaky tests with retries
How do you handle flaky tests in CI?

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Clean up to avoid cost and leaks
